title: Recover failed automated provisioning with an operator retry

outcomes.statement: A non-no-seat invitation failure is sanitized, alerted, and recoverable through a tenant-authorized retry without duplicate unresolved provider execution.
outcomes.demo: Force a provider failure, verify failed state and alert, then retry and verify a legal return to provisioning without duplicate execution.

uncertainties.statement: US-063 must first establish the action identity and unresolved-outcome boundary that retry consumes.
uncertainties.resolution: US-063 reached terminal done in .nous-feedback.jsonl at source commit cfc43292c555fd022ab0395216b0cc514e5f917f, establishing the invitation action identity and unresolved-outcome boundary. US-064 reached terminal done at source commit d8a80197a97691d5c2c57f76f1ffc2f7b3725900, establishing the distinct no-seat route. Both prerequisite deliveries are complete, so no dependency remains execution-blocking for retry.

uncertainties.resolution: The approved US-019 partition in docs/readiness/US-019.json, DEC-SMP-021/CHG-054 canonical allocation (docs/stories/CHANGES.md, CHG-054), the canonical generated child story docs/stories/sprint-3/r1_misc_us_065.md, and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-02-sprint-3-delivery.md section Task 7: Deliver US-019 provisioning and membership confirmation are the inherited design authority. Together they cover this child's allocated acceptance criteria and outcome, stable interfaces, company-scoped authorization, lifecycle/concurrency boundary, non-goals, and verification strategy. This reassessment introduces no new material uncertainty or scope outside that authority; no unresolved material uncertainty remains. The child implementation plan must cite these exact paths and the Task 7 US-019 section as its Spec authority; otherwise a child design is required.

actuals.root_cause: Measured from branch creation at 2026-09-09T01:39:58Z through the authoritative campaign ending at 2026-09-09T08:11:53Z, with the first readiness-bound plan committed after 9 minutes. The cohesive implementation changed 37 raw NUL-delimited Git paths and produced 41 source/test commits at cutoff 4790333, versus the approved 17 files and 8 shards. The expansion came from enforcing the complete vertical boundary: generic provider-failure sanitization and alert atomicity, unresolved-outcome retry fencing, tenant authorization and denial auditing, exact Next.js action composition, both user surfaces and i18n, and fail-closed mutation accountability. Fifteen adversarial review/fix loops closed transaction rollback, concurrency, source-state, HTTP-403, audit-composition, mutation-route, and deterministic-evidence gaps. Review remained below implementation time. The single cache-cleared campaign ran all 12 measured shards in 251 seconds, rounded once to 4 minutes; all shards passed on first contact and the weakest scored shard was 92.31%. The 158-minute variance includes repeated full-gate diagnosis after abandoned Testcontainers starved unrelated Vitest workers; controlled one-worker verification then passed the entire gate without a product-code workaround.
